topic: social-media habits, school, activities, relationships, and future outlook among US teen girls
context: Imagine a nationally representative 2026 survey of US teen girls. Predict the response distribution for the population named in the survey item. These candidate questions were not observed in the American Teenagers Survey and are being used to study whether frontier-model consensus can supply explicitly synthetic calibration targets.

social_media_hours.question_stem: Thinking about a typical day, about how much time do you spend on social media?

posting_frequency.question_stem: Thinking about a typical week, how often do you post or share something publicly or with followers on social media?

late_night_use.question_stem: How often do you use social media after you intended to go to sleep?

sleep_interference.question_stem: How often does social media interfere with getting enough sleep?

social_comparison.question_stem: How often does seeing other people's posts on social media make you feel worse about your own life?

connection_effect.question_stem: Overall, what effect does social media have on how connected you feel to friends?

parental_rules.question_stem: How would you describe the rules your parent or guardian sets about your social-media use?

primary_platform.question_stem: Which social-media platform do you spend the most time on?
option_labels: I do not use social media

school_effort.question_stem: How often do you work hard on schoolwork even when the assignment is difficult or not interesting?

academic_confidence.question_stem: How confident are you that you can do well in your classes when you put in the effort?
academic_confidence.item_text: Confidence in ability to succeed academically

homework_distraction.question_stem: How often does social media make it harder for you to finish homework or study as much as you intended?

organized_activity.question_stem: During a typical week, how often do you take part in organized sports, dance, exercise classes, or another structured physical activity?
option_labels: One or two days a week
Three or more days a week

career_clarity.question_stem: How clear an idea do you currently have about the kind of work or career you might want as an adult?

future_optimism.question_stem: Overall, how optimistic do you feel about your own future?

peer_belonging.question_stem: How often do you feel that you belong and are accepted among people your age?
